items.claim: Jared Cannonier was able to finish Gregory Rodrigues in the later rounds due to fatigue.
items.quote: We saw what Jared Cannonier did to you in those last couple rounds when you couldn't finish him. And then you look hella slow, hella tired in those last couple rounds, and you get smoked.

items.claim: Anthony Hernandez has a good chin to survive early strikes.
items.quote: And he definitely got a nice chin, so let's see what happens.

items.claim: Anthony Hernandez will use his wrestling pace and cardio to tire out Gregory Rodrigues in later rounds.
items.quote: that pace, that wrestling volume, that cardio, that ability to force exhausting transitions is going to catch up to you, Gregory Rodrigues
